subject: The one mistake 90% of users make at 3AM
preview_text: It's not what you think. And it's making your healing take twice as long. I discovered this secret last night.
body_paragraphs: I woke up at 3:17 AM last night. Not from a nightmare. From a memory. It was that stupid inside joke we had about the grocery store. And for a second, I felt that familiar pull to check his Instagram. To see if he was awake too. That's when I realized something terrifying.

The worst thing you can do in a 3AM spiral isn't texting your ex. It's what happens in your head right before you even reach for your phone. You start negotiating with the pain. 'Just one look.' 'It won't hurt.' 'Maybe he's thinking of me too.' That negotiation is where you lose. Every single time.

So I built something into Fresh Start for exactly this moment. It's called Emergency Mode. But most people use it wrong. They wait until they're already crying. The trick is to tap it THE SECOND you feel that negotiation starting. Before the tears. Before the spiral. It's a circuit breaker for your heart.

Open the app right now. Don't wait for 3AM. Find Emergency Mode and just look at it. See the big red button. Your brain needs to know it's there. That's your tiny commitment today. P.S. The first user who tried this trick slept through the night for the first time in 47 days. It works because it stops the war before the first shot is fired.
